atoms.a: Mein Lieblingsessen ist Pizza. Was ist dein Lieblingsessen?
atoms.b: My favourite ((++food drink)) is pizza. ((++What's How's)) your favourite food?
atoms.sound: My favourite food is pizza. What's your favourite food?

atoms.a: Pizza? Ich mag den Käse auf Pizza nicht. Ich liebe Kartoffelbrei mit Gemüse.
atoms.b: Pizza? I don't like the ((++cheese ham)) on pizzas. I love ((++mashed_potato potatos)) with ((++vegetables carrots)).
atoms.sound: Pizza? I don't like the cheese on pizzas. I love mashed potato with vegetables.

atoms.a: Kartoffelbrei mag ich auch. Aber Nudeln mit Tomatensoße finde ich noch besser. Und was hast du gerne in deiner Brotdose?
atoms.b: I like mashed potato, too. But I like ((++pasta rice)) with ((++tomato butter)) sauce better. And what do you like to have in your ((++lunch_box bag))?
atoms.sound: I like mashed potato, too. But I like pasta with tomato sauce better. And what do you like to have in your lunch box?

atoms.a: Ich habe immer belegte Brote und Gurke in meiner Brotdose. Manchmal habe ich Obst dabei. Und du?
atoms.b: I always have ((++sandwiches bread)) and ((++cucumber tomato)) in my lunch box. Sometimes I bring ((++fruit apples)). And you?
atoms.sound: I always have sandwiches and cucumber in my lunch box. Sometimes I bring fruit. And you?

atoms.a: Ich habe auch immer belegte Brote und Gemüse dabei. Aber ich mag keine Gurken.
atoms.b: I always have sandwiches and ((++vegetables carrots)) in my lunch box too. But I don't like ((++cucumbers carrots)).
atoms.sound: I always have sandwiches and vegetables in my lunch box, too. But I don't like cucumbers.

atoms.a: Manchmal habe ich Erdbeeren oder Bananen dabei. Magst du Obst?
atoms.b: Sometimes I bring ((++strawberries oranges)) or ((++bananas cherries)). Do you like ((++fruit cherries))?
atoms.sound: Sometimes I bring strawberries or bananas. Do you like fruit?

atoms.a: Ja! Ich mag Obst auch zum Frühstück in meinem Müsli.
atoms.b: Yes, I do! I also like fruit for ((++breakfast dinner)) on my ((++cereal milk)).
atoms.sound: Yes,I do! I also like fruit for breakfast on my cereal.

atoms.a: Ich auch. Was ist dein Lieblingsgetränk für die Schule? Ich trinke am liebsten Limonade.
atoms.b: Me too. What is your favourite ((++drink food)) for school? I love to drink ((++lemonade water)).
atoms.sound: Me too. What is your favourite drink for school? I love to drink lemonade.

atoms.a: Limonade ist mir zu süß! Ich nehme immer Wasser mit zur Schule.
atoms.b: Lemonade is too ((++sweet bitter)) for me! I always bring ((++water juice)) to school.
atoms.sound: Lemonade is too sweet for me! I always bring water to school.
